name: gitops (vibe MacBook / Cloud Agent)
install:
set -eo pipefail
if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in colima kind helm kubernetes-cli; do brew list --formula "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install "$f"; done; exit 0; fi
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
TFLINT_VER=0.64.0
TOFU_VER="$(cat terraform/.opentofu-version)"
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3-yaml unzip curl >/dev/null
python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages --quiet --upgrade pre-commit uv
if ! tofu version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "v${TOFU_VER}$"; then tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/tofu.zip" "https://github.com/opentofu/opentofu/releases/download/v${TOFU_VER}/tofu_${TOFU_VER}_linux_amd64.zip"; unzip -oq "$tmp/tofu.zip" tofu -d "$tmp"; sudo install "$tmp/tofu" /usr/local/bin/tofu; rm -rf "$tmp"; fi
if ! tflint --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "version ${TFLINT_VER}$"; then tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/tflint.zip" "https://github.com/terraform-linters/tflint/releases/download/v${TFLINT_VER}/tflint_linux_amd64.zip"; unzip -oq "$tmp/tflint.zip" tflint -d "$tmp"; sudo install "$tmp/tflint" /usr/local/bin/tflint; rm -rf "$tmp"; fi
